herbs.name: Gan Cao (Licorice Root)
herbs.indications: Sore throat, cough, palpitations, stomach ulcers
herbs.safety: Avoid in high doses with hypertension, pregnancy, kidney disease.

herbs.name: Dang Shen (Codonopsis Root)
herbs.indications: Fatigue, poor appetite, shortness of breath, loose stools
herbs.safety: Avoid in excess dampness or acute fever.

herbs.name: Huang Qi (Astragalus Root)
herbs.indications: Chronic fatigue, prolapse, night sweats, weak digestion
herbs.safety: Avoid during acute infection with fever.

herbs.name: Ren Shen (Ginseng Root)
herbs.indications: Extreme fatigue, weakness after illness, shortness of breath
herbs.safety: Avoid in hypertension, acute heat, and with stimulants.

herbs.name: Bai Zhu (Atractylodes Root)
herbs.indications: Poor appetite, bloating, loose stools, edema
herbs.safety: Avoid deficiency of fluids with dry constipation.

herbs.name: Ju Hua (Chrysanthemum Flower)
herbs.indications: Red eyes, headache, hypertension, dizziness
herbs.safety: Use with caution in deficient cold.

herbs.name: Bo He (Mint)
herbs.indications: Sore throat, common cold, stress, skin rash (topical)
herbs.safety: Avoid in excessive sweating or qi deficiency.

herbs.name: Chai Hu (Bupleurum Root)
herbs.indications: Stress, mood swings, chest tightness, menstrual pain
herbs.safety: Avoid in yin deficiency with internal heat.

herbs.name: Sheng Jiang (Fresh Ginger)
herbs.indications: Morning sickness, nausea, common cold, poor appetite
herbs.safety: Avoid in hot conditions or yin deficiency.

herbs.name: Da Zao (Jujube Date)
herbs.indications: Fatigue, palpitations, insomnia, dry skin
herbs.safety: Safe for most, avoid in excess dampness.

herbs.name: Shan Zha (Hawthorn Berry)
herbs.indications: Bloating, indigestion, high cholesterol, meat stagnation
herbs.safety: Avoid on an empty stomach; caution in pregnancy.

herbs.name: Yi Yi Ren (Coix Seed)
herbs.indications: Edema, arthritis, warts, loose stools
herbs.safety: Avoid in pregnancy and severe spleen deficiency.

herbs.name: Pu Gong Ying (Dandelion)
herbs.indications: Mastitis, acne, urinary infection, sore throat
herbs.safety: Avoid in cold deficiency and with low blood pressure.

herbs.name: Huang Lian (Coptis Root)
herbs.indications: Diarrhea, insomnia, mouth ulcers, skin boils
herbs.safety: Avoid in deficiency cold; short-term use only.

herbs.name: Chen Pi (Dried Tangerine Peel)
herbs.indications: Bloating, chest tightness, nausea, phlegm cough
herbs.safety: Avoid in yin deficiency with dry throat.

herbs.name: Fu Ling (Poria Mushroom)
herbs.indications: Edema, loose stools, anxiety, insomnia
herbs.safety: Avoid in yin deficiency with no dampness.

herbs.name: Bai Shao (White Peony Root)
herbs.indications: Menstrual pain, night sweats, muscle spasms
herbs.safety: Avoid in diarrhea with deficiency cold.

herbs.name: Dan Shen (Red Sage Root)
herbs.indications: Chest pain, menstrual problems, insomnia
herbs.safety: Avoid with blood thinners; caution in pregnancy.

herbs.name: Tian Ma (Gastrodia Tuber)
herbs.indications: Headaches, dizziness, seizures, neuralgia
herbs.safety: Use caution in pregnancy, minimal side effects.

herbs.name: Xia Ku Cao (Prunella Spike)
herbs.indications: Red eyes, hypertension, thyroid nodules, headache
herbs.safety: Avoid in yin deficiency cold pattern.
